messages:
zoe_cs: Heads up 1 Hawthorn procurement wants to move 10 seats to their EU subsidiary and keep 5 on the US parent. They also request a one-time onboarding credit of $2,500 and want invoices split by entity. PO they uploaded references old legal name and missing VAT. Can Billing + Legal advise on next steps?
matt_sales: We can split seats. Need effective date to prorate. Will confirm pricing with manager for the credit.
tori_billing: Split invoices OK. Need: (1) how many seats per entity, (2) effective date, (3) VAT/Tax ID for EU entity, (4) PO number per entity. If PO name mismatch, finance will ask for corrected PO before issuing invoice.
ana_legal: Correction: ana_legal here. For e-sign vs wet-sign? They said e-sign ok but EU entity needs signed attestation for authority. We'll add attestation clause: "Signer attests authority to bind entity." Also we prefer scanned signature only if customer insists.
zoe_cs: Effective date = 2024-06-01. Seats: EU = 10, US = 5. Seat rate unchanged at $1,050/seat/yr. I told them credit applies to first invoice for EU entity.
matt_sales: Manager approved onboarding credit $2,500 for this arrangement. We'll keep standard term; no term shortening.
tori_billing: Proration formula applied. For remaining term days = 259, total term = 365. I'll calculate amounts and post sample invoice lines by EOD. Need VAT ID and corrected PO by 2024-05-28 to hit billing window.
ana_legal: Draft amendment will include split billing clause, credit clause (non-transferable), and signature attestation. I can turn around draft in 24 hrs.
docu_sign_bot: DocuSign envelope queued (hawthorn-split-2024). Standard e-sign flow.
zoe_cs: I'll ask procurement to upload corrected PO and VAT and send signatory email. If they push for wet-sign we escalate to Legal. Posting draft when ready. :pray:
